## Linked Issue

Refs #2295

Bounded SOURCE intake of accepted [#4395](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/pull/4395), original work [#2122](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2122) and [#2123](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/2123). No issue closure or runtime/consumer acceptance.

## Scope Summary

Exact reviewed base #4385 `b302f58a9aaee9f2399d9274157a478f3c2f78fb`. Receive only six exact production blobs from Storage conflict presentation #4395 `8ea2ef029ab320674321884202e9e163a50abff2`. New source commit `20e3db62b100b7944594ad7fa3156a01b4994d95`, source tree `8fbdd19dd95b80eee0af8826939e6e7dc65d2b23`, final WIP head `d86aa14df538439b1fbeffcb80bf172a73d88fe6`. Source commit has the fixed4385 sole parent; no donor history, WIP, tests, backend or unrelated source imported. All existing base files/evidence remain unchanged.

Six source files/1139 lines under `src/frontend/src/components/article-vault/`: VaultConflictList.vue, VaultResolutionStatus.vue, VaultStoredConflictReview.vue, conflictEvidencePresentation.ts, resolutionStatusPresentation.ts, storedConflictReviewPresentation.ts. All absent at target; no production source conflict. Actual clean UI973 `41a127611fa3db054b7d5bca25aeb101f2401ef6` is the real local alias, both public package aliases resolve to its actual index. No UI edits/publication, fake packages, reduced configs, stubs, casts or gate relaxation. This independent sibling does not touch any parallel intake branch.

WIP deliberately remains incomplete: the original source-only FsusUI boundary checker adds one warning (20->21) for the exact donor's direct public ElPagination import. Original locked lint tools are absent and setup remains HOLD pending the narrowly asked installation decision. Neither finding is waived by donor SOURCE acceptance.
